notes:
# Orvio 0.49

- Catch-up works again: channels that keep recordings show ⟲. On TV, hold OK on a channel for Catch-up, programme info and favourites; on phones, use the ⟲ button next to the playing channel. After this update Orvio refreshes your playlist once in the background to find these channels.
- Duplicate entries in the catch-up list are merged.
- Languages shown first now follow your device's language and country instead of always Dutch; entries that are not languages (such as "UFC") left the list. Your own choice is kept.
- TV sign-in: the e-mail and password fields are the same, more compact size.
